title.narrative: Prevention of Re-establishment of Malaria in Timor-Leste - Timor-Leste (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Timor-Leste, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste (MOH)This program has the following goals: To remain malaria free of indigenous malaria in Timor-Leste. The objectives of this program are: To prevent the re-establishment of malaria in the country. To maintain zero mortality due to locally acquired malaria

Annual blood examination rate: per 100 population per year (Elimination settings)
Proportion of malaria cases detected by the surveillance system
Proportion of population at risk potentially covered by distributed ITNs
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for TLS-M-MOHP05
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Number of insecticide-treated nets distributed to populations at risk of malaria transmission through mass campaigns
Number of insecticide-treated nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at private sector sites
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community

Percentage of malaria foci fully investigated and classified as per the national guidance
